summary: Implemented the rich.progress open/wrap_file feature across rich/progress.py, tests/test_progress.py, docs/source/progress.rst, and CHANGELOG.md. All changes are additive (773 insertions, 0 deletions) and nothing is committed. I did not run tests, black, isort, or mypy, since the instructions ruled out running repository code, so everything was verified by reading only. Key choices: the context wrapper is a @contextmanager generator; the module-level open implementation takes mode: Any so the overloaded Progress.open accepts it; suppressions are limited to readline (override), readinto (no-untyped-def and override), and the handle's readinto call (attr-defined). Before merging, run the test suite, black, isort, and mypy strict, since the mypy suppressions are the most likely source of noise.
